_comment: BAND-SPLIT-2. See band1_lower_meadows/vegetation.json for why this file exists. `order` equals the index this entry would hold in the merged pre-split array, and is reserved against Band 3's 3000-3999 range like every other band-scoped config here (see tests/test_band_vegetation.gd's own note on why).

clearings._why: GATE-D3. The flat shoulder just past the spine's own bend into the relay approach ((230,3670) is a spine waypoint) -- measured with tools/_probe_band3.gd at 0.35m of spread over an 8m box, the flattest ground found anywhere in the band. This is the region's answer to prompt 64's camp/rest requirement: not a pre-built healer inside the gauntlet, but a real clearing, off the pickets' own ground and before either of them, where the player can actually plant a camp and rest before pushing in. A copse standing on it would defeat the point -- the camp placer needs open, walkable ground, the same reason clearings exist for every other hand-placed structure in the game.

_comment_layer_anchors_vp4: VP4-CORRIDOR round 4 (JUDGE-b3b5-before.md). Merged onto the matching head-layer's own `anchors` by `scripts/world/scatter_rules.gd::_merge_band_layer_anchors` (see band1_lower_meadows/vegetation.json's own comment on this key for the merge mechanism). Fixes stations 09-river-lock-entry and 10-relay-approach. Station 09's own name promises water ('the river lock') that this position genuinely cannot show -- `data/config/water.json`'s river `course` runs z 4080-4222 (the same river station 12/old-mill-crossing already frames well), ~800-900m further down the route than this station's z=3290; moving the station that close to 12 would just duplicate it and leave a gap earlier in the band. So this fixes the one part of the complaint vegetation actually reaches -- the 'empty grass to sky' mid-ground absence -- honestly, not by faking a water feature that isn't there. Checked clear of this file's own clearing above (210,3700 r11, the river-lock rest pad) before siting.

trees._why: VP4 station 09-river-lock-entry (-110,3290)->(-160,3420): JUDGE-b3b5-before.md ranked this the second-worst station -- 'a worn dirt path receding into open grass... no rock, no copse, no structure'. A tree copse 30m out at 22 degrees off the view axis, right side.

VP4 station 10-relay-approach (230,3670)->(350,3760): JUDGE-b3b5-before.md -- 'the left half of the frame is still just open field and sky' while the right side (signpost, campfire, tree wall, a banner glimpsed through the trees) does all the work. A copse claiming the left half, 30m out at 22 degrees off-axis, so the frame converges on the relay ahead rather than reading half-empty. Clear of the river-lock rest clearing (210,3700 r11, 44.6m away) and of `relay_approach_checkpoint`'s own prop cluster (240.9,3673.7, 18.2m away -- close enough to stand behind the checkpoint's own furniture, not on top of it).

rocks._why: VP4 station 09-river-lock-entry: a near-camera rock/reed-adjacent cluster on the left, 15m out at 15 degrees off-axis -- close enough to read as foreground, per the judge's own suggested fix ('a foreground rock/reed cluster camera-left'). `min_slope_deg` 0, same gentle-meadow override every rock anchor in this pass uses.

bushes._why: VP4 station 09: edge planting beside the new rock cluster.
VP4 station 10: edge planting on the new left-side copse.
